hero.sub: Your cleaning service for private and commercial clients in Pulheim, Cologne and the surrounding area — thorough, reliable and at a fixed price.

services.headline: What we do for you.
services.sub: One contact for glass, interiors and façades — tailored to private clients, property managers and businesses.

glass.title: Glass & window cleaning
glass.body: Streak-free, thorough, on time — inside and out, including frames and sills.

upkeep.title: Maintenance cleaning
upkeep.body: Regular care for stairwells, offices, medical practices and commercial spaces.

deep.title: Deep cleaning
deep.body: One-off thorough cleaning after a move, renovation or completion of construction.

facade.title: Façade & solar panel cleaning
facade.body: Careful cleaning of façades, conservatories and photovoltaic installations.

about.headline: Family business from Pulheim — for over 15 years.
about.body: We're a small, well-coordinated team. You get a single point of contact, a clear quote and a result you can see. No subcontractor merry-go-round, no hidden costs.
about.bullet4: Service area: Pulheim, Cologne, Frechen, Brauweiler

process.headline: Three steps to a clean result.
process.step1Body: Phone, mail or the form — tell us briefly what needs cleaning.
process.step2Body: We get back to you the same working day with a clear fixed price and your preferred date.
process.step3Body: Our team arrives on time, works thoroughly — and you pay after the job is done.

pricing.headline: What you hear is what you pay.
pricing.body: We don't like surprises on the invoice — and we're guessing you don't either. That's why we always work to an agreed fixed price.
pricing.point1Body: You get a written fixed price before work starts. No timesheet surprises.
pricing.point2Body: For larger jobs we come on site and price it accurately — with no travel charge.
pricing.point3Body: Professional liability up to €5M. If anything breaks, you're covered.
pricing.point4Body: You only pay once the result is right — by bank transfer or in cash on site.

references.headline: What customers are saying.
references.sub: Excerpts from feedback by our clients.
references.ref1Quote: A&L do excellent work at the Johanniter-Stift Brauweiler. Despite the size of the property — 80 resident rooms and 24 apartments — every window and glass door is cleaned thoroughly and streak-free. The service is reliable, professional and friendly — absolutely recommended!
references.ref2Quote: From first contact to execution everything ran smoothly, professionally and very pleasantly. All panes came out streak-free, even hard-to-reach spots were done thoroughly. The price/quality ratio is genuinely fair — I can recommend them without reservation!
references.ref3Quote: We're very happy with the team. Thanks for the thorough work. Very professional and reliable. You can tell quality and customer satisfaction matter here. Everything went smoothly — we'll definitely book them again.

serviceArea.headline: We come to you — across the Rhein-Erft district and Cologne.
serviceArea.body: Pulheim is our base; Cologne and the surrounding municipalities are home to us. Other addresses on request.
serviceArea.mapAlt: Service map: three zones around Pulheim Mitte covering Cologne, Frechen, Brauweiler, Bergheim, Kerpen, Brühl and Hürth.

items.q: How quickly do I get a quote?
items.a: You'll hear from us the same working day — by phone or email. For straightforward jobs (windows, an apartment) we give you the fixed price right away. For larger spaces we come on site and quote in person.

items.q: Do you charge by the hour or a fixed price?
items.a: Fixed price. You know the cost before work starts — no open timesheets, no renegotiation. If the scope is hard to estimate we make a short site visit first.

items.q: Are you insured if something gets damaged?
items.a: Yes. We carry professional liability insurance up to €5M, covering both personal injury and property damage during the job.
Gladly — we maintain stairwells, offices and medical practices weekly, fortnightly or monthly. We set up a fixed schedule with a consistent point of contact.

items.q: What service area do you cover?
items.a: Pulheim and Cologne are our focus. We regularly serve Frechen, Brauweiler, Bergheim, Bedburg, Kerpen and Dormagen. Addresses outside that radius are welcome on request.
